bash scripts/agent-cursor-delegate.sh --work-dir "$WD" --prompt 'Reply with exactly the word pong and nothing else. Do not use tools.' --mode permissive --interaction-mode non-interactive --task-id dml-cursor-ni --no-escalate --log "$WD/logs/cursor-ni.log"

echo '--- events ---'

echo '--- ps unique ---'
sort -u "$PSLOG" | head -20
echo '--- log tail ---'
tail -c 800 "$WD/logs/cursor-ni.log"
